Description

Research the effects of LEO conditions on a quantum gyroscope based on nitrogen vacancy centers in diamond. Exceed resolution, sensitivity, and drift stability limits of conventional gyroscopes (MEMs). Receive telemetry and ESR-level experimental data from payload to establish viability for future space applications.
